_meta.purpose: EDU01 R1 — a-priori wave definitions for exact-phrase title classification (step 18).
_meta.matching: Titles are cleaned (LaTeX/MathML removed), lower-cased, and hyphens replaced by spaces before case-insensitive regular-expression matching; an article belongs to a wave if any include pattern matches and no exclude pattern matches. An article may belong to more than one wave.
_meta.revision_log: Quantum wave broadened once (2026-11-02), before validation coding, after inspection of T-QE titles showed that the hardware-only phrase set excluded quantum-computing engineering articles that the course-side keywords ('quantum comput', 'quantum information') would count; the research and teaching operationalisations were aligned. Quantum communication/QKD/post-quantum cryptography excluded on both sides. | Round-1 precision inspection (seed 20261102) found systematic false positives: dynamical-systems papers on stability/synchronization of 'memristive neural networks' (AI hardware), RRAM-for-TCAM and in-memory ECC codecs, rapid single-flux-quantum (classical superconducting) logic, and editorial items (calls for papers, guest editorials, covers). Exclusion rules and a non-research filter (applied to the pool denominator as well) were added; precision was then re-estimated on a fresh random sample (seed 20261103). | Round-2 held-out validation (seed 20261103): precision 44/50, 49/50, 50/50, 48/50 but near-miss recall low (missed 9/30, 13/30, 1/30, 7/30 of near-miss titles; e.g., 'LSTM accelerator', 'spiking networks', 'synaptic TFT', hyphenated 'quantum-annealing-aided'). Patterns extended (hyphen normalisation, accelerator x ML-term co-occurrence, spiking/synapse/event-camera terms, stabilizer/surface codes). Final rules frozen and validated on a third fresh sample (seed 20261104). | Round-3 (final, seed 20261104): precision AI 43/50, NE 50/50, SE 48/50, QU 45/50; near-miss misses 7/30, 0/30, 1/30, 6/30. Rules frozen. After coding, the non-research filter was extended to annual index items ('2021 Index IEEE ...'), which the round-3 sample had exposed; the coded sample was not regenerated (the index item remains coded 0 in the precision estimate).
_meta.non_research_filter: ^(front cover|back cover|table of contents|toc|.*call for papers.*|guest editorial.*|editorial.*|.*information for authors.*|ieee .* (information|society)$|.*reviewers.*|correction(s)? to .*|erratum.*|retraction.*|.*special issue.*|introducing ieee .*|.*index$|\d{4} index .*|.*masthead.*)$
